comment: JP2 0064: Suter's commentary, first page (p. [32]): introduction to the text (text pp. 1-2): the word zīj; the early Arabic tables after the Indian Siddhāntas; the two editions of the Sindhind of al-Khwārizmī; Maslama's recension; the Brahma- and Sūrya-Siddhānta; the Persian tables of the Shāh (notes 1-2).

observations: The first page of Suter's commentary; the page number, 32 by the sequence of pages, is not printed. The page begins about a quarter of the way down: L01 «KOMMENTAR» in capitals, with a short rule below it; L02 «Einleitung des Textes.» in bold, centred; L03 «(Text p. 1—2.)», centred. The page has no signature.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: the names «Ibrāhīm al-Fazārī», «Yaʿḳūb b. Ṭāriḳ», «Muh. b. Mūsā al-Khwārizmī», «Al-Ma’mūns», «Yaḥyā b. Abī Manṣūr», «Sened b. ʿAlī», «ʿAbbās b. Saʿīd al-Djauharī», «Kh.» (Suter's abbreviation of al-Khwārizmī), «Maslama al-Madjrīṭī», «Brahmagupta», «Suter», «Batt.» (al-Battānī) and «Nallino»; italics: the Arabic and Persian words and the titles. «Muh.» without a dot under the h.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-12 px measured).
